comment: Positive WebAssembly spec-suite baseline. The 'core' subset is enforced by .github/workflows/spectest.yml; 'simd' is a recorded reference (a clean SIMD run). Metrics come from real harness runs - never hand-edit. Generators: 'core' = run_spectest.ps1 -Subset core -MaxPerWast 10; 'simd' = run_spectest.ps1 -Subset simd -MaxPerWast 10. Regenerate one subset with: python3 test-scripts/check-spectest.py --summary <summary.json> --subset <core|simd> --update
